scenario.topic: Pick the soundtrack style for the indie game project

options.name: Orchestral Fantasy Score
options.upside: Creates a rich, cinematic atmosphere that enhances the fantasy setting.
options.concern: Higher production costs and longer recording sessions may strain the budget.

options.name: Chiptune Retro Soundtrack
options.upside: Faster and more affordable production with a distinctive retro vibe.
options.concern: May not fully match the immersive fantasy atmosphere desired.

options.name: Ambient Electronic Soundscape
options.upside: Supports immersion with subtle, mood-enhancing textures.

options.name: Folk Acoustic Ensemble
options.upside: Offers a natural, intimate sound that complements fantasy themes.
options.concern: Recording live instruments requires coordination and may extend timelines.

shared_context: The team needs to select a soundtrack style for an indie game with a fantasy setting. The soundtrack should support immersion, fit a moderate budget, and be feasible to produce within three months.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a game designer who values efficient, budget-conscious solutions.
personas.private_goal: To select a soundtrack that is affordable and quick to produce without sacrificing charm.

A.reason_against: Higher production costs and longer recording sessions may strain the budget and timeline.

B.reason_for: Faster and more affordable production with a distinctive retro vibe.

C.reason_against: Less melodic content might reduce emotional engagement for some players.

D.reason_for: Offers a natural, intimate sound that complements fantasy themes.
D.reason_against: Recording live instruments requires coordination and may extend timelines.
